notes: Claude Code exposes topmind via the Skill tool (look for SKILL.md / skills.md in the dropped pack).
v4.3 progressive disclosure: host indexes name+description for all packaged skills; load SKILL.md body on activation; load shared/ and skill references/ only when linked.
Single daily user entry remains topmind. Sub-skill descriptions are discovery aids — not parallel products. Keep Action Map + trigger-disambiguation contract.
MCP integration is optional — enable topmind-mcp if the user wants deterministic UTR commands surfaced as tools.
Categories use NN-Name spaced number prefix (dynamic discovery); topics use YYYY-主题 kebab-case; do not introduce YYYY-类型-项目名.
Claude Code is case-insensitive on macOS / Windows by default — the canonical lowercase `skills.md` covers both `skills.md` and `SKILLS.md` lookups.
